description: Kernel-mystery probe (T-1778 round 3, erfc-probes): does NORM.S.DIST(-y,TRUE) equal ERFC.PRECISE(y/sqrt2)/2 bit for bit in the erfc tail, and which rounding of y/sqrt2 does it use? Runs of 512 consecutive y. A = y; B = NORM.S.DIST(-y,TRUE); C = y*sqrt(0.5) and D = y/sqrt(2) as constants (single IEEE double roundings, computed outside Excel); E = ERFC.PRECISE(C)/2; F = ERFC.PRECISE(D)/2; G = NORM.DIST(-y,0,1,TRUE); H = ERFC.PRECISE(A*SQRT(0.5))/2 (Excel arithmetic). Halving is exact.
